events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/daily_reminders.py:150` constructs `email = EmailMultiAlternatives(...)`, but `EmailMultiAlternatives` is never imported in the module. Sending the test daily check-in reminder raises `NameError: name 'EmailMultiAlternatives' is not defined`, so the reminder email is never sent.

## Repro

Invoke the daily-reminder send path that reaches line 150 → NameError.

## Suggested fix

    from django.core.mail import EmailMultiAlternatives

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the name. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
